mapper.select:
SELECT , count(b."書籍ID") AS "bookCount" FROM public."RED_書籍分類情報" c LEFT JOIN public."RED_書籍情報" b ON b."分類ID" = c."分類ID"
WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY c."分類ID" ORDER BY c."表示順" ASC, c."分類ID" ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE public."RED_書籍分類情報" SET "分類名" = #{name}, "表示順" = #{displayOrder}, "説明" = #{description}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{updatedBy}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "分類ID" = #{categoryId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."RED_書籍分類情報" WHERE "分類ID" = #{categoryId}
